FOR THE DRAFT NATIONAL POLLUTANT DISCHARGE ELIMINATION SYSTEM
(NPDES) PERMIT TO DISCHARGE TO WATERS OF THE UNITED STATES
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether this fact sheet describes a draft permit rather than an issued, enforceable permit affects whether its terms can establish applicable numeric discharge limits (A), binding monitoring obligations (B), and the monitoring expectations used to classify missing or no-data evidence (C) for Federal FY2025.

candidates.exact_span:
Proposed reissuance of the current National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES)
permit issued September 30, 2016, with an effective date of November 1, 2016, and an
expiration date of October 31, 2021.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The stated effective and expiration dates, together with the proposed (not finalized) reissuance status, bear on whether this permit term covers Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30). Different readings change which enforceable limits are in force (A), which permit-year or term-dependent monitoring requirements apply (B), and whether missing-evidence cases should be evaluated against this permit's expectations (C).
